description:
Doomscroll your vocab.

Turn a spare minute on your iPhone into time with the words you want to remember. Schwanki brings vocabulary flashcards into a swipeable feed, with pictures, example sentences and audio when your cards include them.

YOUR WORDS, A BETTER FEED
See a word. Try to remember it. Tap to reveal the meaning, read it in context and hear it aloud. Swipe or choose Again, Hard, Good or Easy to tell Schwanki how it went. Spaced repetition schedules what comes next.

BRING YOUR DECK
Import an Anki .apkg or .colpkg export from Files. Preview the decks, choose the language and bring across supported cards, review history, scheduling and media. Imports are a one-time transfer, not a connection to AnkiWeb. Native imports support files up to 30 MB; larger decks can go through Schwanki on the web.

REVIEW AT YOUR PACE
Choose a deck, set a daily new-card limit and add an optional reminder. Review cards and media already saved on your iPhone without a connection. Your saved reviews sync to your Schwanki account when you reconnect.

CREATE ON THE WEB. REVIEW ON IPHONE.
Use the same Schwanki account on your iPhone and at schwankiapp.com. The website is where you turn notes and class documents into cards, edit vocabulary and generate pictures, examples and audio. The iPhone app is for importing decks and reviewing your words. AI creation and document connections are web features; generated content may contain mistakes.

TRY THE FEED FIRST
Explore three sample cards without signing in. A Google account and an internet connection are required to sign in and sync your own library. Some web creation features use paid credits; no credit purchase is needed to try the sample feed.

Schwanki is independent and is not affiliated with Anki, AnkiWeb, AnkiMobile or Google.
